study: Original annual 2005 SEC filings, Hurricane Katrina; second source review performed without access to predictions.

PR05.controls: The $900m loss on pre-tax net income in the 2005 total is for all large catastrophes in the table. Rita and Wilma have their own rows. The 2004 Atlantic-storm line belongs to a different calendar year. Closing parentheses often occupy the adjacent HTML cell.

XL05.controls: Rita, Wilma and other catastrophes have separate rows within each block. The Katrina Financial Products and Services recovery is a dash. Underwriting loss, tax benefit, net loss and loss-ratio impact refer to all listed catastrophes. The 2005 hurricane paragraph elsewhere gives an estimated net loss after recoveries; that separate amount is not printed as a Katrina cell here.

AS05.controls: The same physical row includes California brush fires and $15.3m in a separate 2003 column. The 2004 header applies to that middle column group only. Rita $43.5m, Wilma $15.8m, the refinery fire and the print-works fire are other losses. Property Reinsurance is the segment, not the consolidated owner.
